krisyangdev-motionboard-motionboard.description: Make product launch videos, promo videos and motion graphics in code with HyperFrames (HTML + GSAP rendered to MP4), from 38 shot recipes taken from Apple and Linear launch films. Use when the user asks to make a launch video, product video, promo or app trailer; asks for a specific effect such as a match cut transition, logo reveal or logo animation, text scramble, kinetic typography, typing / typewriter animation, word-by-word text highlight, morph transition, wipe or iris transition, liquid glass effect, chromatic aberration / RGB split, line boil, dot matrix animation, confetti success…
